name: Clean up
description: Reclaim space from rebuildable caches, old logs, temporary files, and leftovers.
note: Enabled cache cleanup permanently removes files. Preview the cleanup first; Mole checks targets against its protection rules. Protected paths opens an editable manager.
flags: Show what would change without removing files.

fields.label: External volume
fields.hint: Optional. Clean macOS metadata on this mounted volume.

name: Uninstall apps
description: Remove applications and the leftovers that belong to them.
note: Trash is the default. Mole checks for other installed copies before removing shared app data. Select your apps in Terminal, or enter exact uninstall names below.
flags: Show exact names accepted by Mole.
Bypass Trash. Items cannot be restored from Trash.

fields.label: App names
fields.hint: One exact app name per line. Leave blank to use the app selector.

name: Disk explorer
description: Find what’s taking up space, then decide what to keep.
note: Browse your home folder below. Select personal files to review a recoverable move to Trash. Use the terminal analyzer for full-disk exploration.
flags: Output measured sizes and scan completeness.

fields.label: Analyze path
fields.hint: Optional. Leave blank for Mole’s disk overview.

name: Optimize
description: Run focused maintenance for macOS caches, databases, and services.
note: Mole skips tasks that are unnecessary or unsafe. Preview the pass before running maintenance.

name: Project cleanup
description: Clear rebuildable project artifacts while protecting your source code.
note: Selected artifacts are permanently deleted. Git-tracked content, nested repositories, and deployment keys are protected by Mole.
flags: Explicitly confirm all eligible artifacts without interactive selection.

name: Old installers
description: Find installer files you no longer need.
note: Mole discovers supported DMG, PKG, MPKG, ISO, XIP, and installer ZIP files. Selected installers are permanently removed. Review the exact selection in Terminal first.

name: System health
description: A closer look at your Mac’s current health.
note: Refresh for a one-time snapshot. Continuous monitoring is available through Mole’s terminal status view.

name: Activity history
description: See what Mole changed, skipped, or kept.
note: Activity is read from Mole’s operation logs. A Terminal launch is only a handoff; the logs record what actually happened.

name: Touch ID
description: Use your fingerprint for sudo authentication.
note: Changes to authentication are performed by Mole in Terminal, with its existing authorization flow.

name: Shell completion
description: Make your next terminal command a little easier.
note: Automatic setup edits your shell configuration. Selecting a shell prints its completion script for manual installation.

name: Update Mole
note: This runs Mole’s existing update flow. Choose nightly only if you want the development version.
flags: Reinstall even when the current version matches.
Install the development version from main.

name: Remove Mole
note: Mole previews the selected installation and preserves non-default configuration roots for manual review.

name: Command help
note: Open the built-in help in Terminal.

name: Version
description: Check the version of Mole you are running.
note: Show the version of the selected Mole executable.
